title: Optional cdxgen SBOM generator runtime configuration
observed_behavior: internal/adapters/sbom/cdxgen.go already provided an optional executable adapter, but production app wiring constructed NewGeneratorRegistry(NewSyftGenerator(), nil), so operators could not enable cdxgen-backed CycloneDX repository generation.
intended_behavior: Bahia exposes runtime config for cdxgen enablement and binary path, wires NewCdxgenGenerator into production SBOM generator registry only when enabled, preserves Syft as the disabled/default fallback, and fails clearly when generator=cdxgen is explicitly requested but unavailable.
